question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which character do you want to see more of?
Which movie genre is your favorite?

nodes.text: Howard waves his hand!
Howard waits as Dyre leads the students through the school motto.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you doing? He's into the school motto already!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wave that hand! Wave it like the Queen on coronation day!
Howard waves his hand!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is my chance!
Howard waves his hand.
Howard waits as Dyre talks about school pride.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: And now that we know how proud we are of our school... Everyone together, as we recite the school motto! Say it with pride.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: 'At Centerscore, enlightenment is what we must find...'

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: 'While adhering to authority in heart and mind...'

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: 'At Centerscore, we have lots of school pride...'

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: 'And in our leadership we must abide!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is the worst motto ever! Now's as good a time as any for a smoke bomb.
Howard waves his hand!
Howard waits as Dyre proceeds to run through the rest of the protocols.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: At last Protocol-100B: No sounds reproducing any bodily function can be made on campus.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Follow these protocols, and Centerscore will be a healthy, happy place for you all!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to remind you that here at Centerscore, we should be proud as a group of our ability to adhere to the rules!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Remember, Lyle the Lizard's best quality is his obedience! Be proud of all that you've achieved. No more is Centerscore a cesspool of teenage drama...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, he's talking about school pride...
Let's check in with Hector and Howard... Can you help them get $Scott through the school?
The bell rings, and Howard and Hector slip into the green room backstage as other students file into morning assembly...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, you ready?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can we go over the plan again?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're here to take over the school. We have to get all the students to scatter, and we have to make sure we give Dyre the chance to see $Scott for phase three of the plan.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Scott's going to get into position to run in front of Dyre, and I'll be prepping the smoke bombs.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You signal $Scott to run.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dyre always does the exact same things in the morning assembly. He lists the protocols, threatens us with school pride, and leads us in reciting the dumb school motto.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When Dyre starts talking about school pride, wave your hand. That's when $Scott will run, and I'll activate the smoke bombs!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right.
Howard ducks out of the classroom and hides in the stage's curtains.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Good morning, students of Centerscore! Welcome to another day at your favorite school.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: It grieves me to tell you that there have been some `incidents` lately that force me to remind everyone of the protocols.
nodes.text_bbcode: It grieves me to tell you that there have been some [color=#e23b3b][i]incidents[/i][/color] lately that force me to remind everyone of the protocols.

nodes.text: The students groan until a look from Dyre stifles them.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Protocol-1: Students must listen to the directives of Principal Dyre and his C.R.E.E.P. associates at all times.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Protocol-2: Sports are subversive and cause degradation of the mind.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Protocol-3: Students cannot openly question authority... Protocol-4: Students must not...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here we go... He's talking about protocols. What should I do?
As Phil walks away, the bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh-oh, it's showtime.
They walk into the auditorium and find seats.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Take that, Dyre! See if C.R.E.E.P. comes to help when something `explosive` happens! Hee hee!
nodes.text_bbcode: Take that, Dyre! See if C.R.E.E.P. comes to help when something [color=#3b78e2][i]explosive[/i][/color] happens! Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Frickin' fantastic! We barely distracted C.R.E.E.P. at all!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This had better not screw up the plan!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I knew that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Of course. I've made the same point before, and I'm making the same point again. I've worn uniforms: basketball, football, and banana.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You had a banana costume?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Don't change the subject. What I'm trying to say is that I know girls don't like uniforms. But that's not why I took this job.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I took this job because girls like authority!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: And right now, I have the authority to write you up for stopping a C.R.E.E.P. officer from making his daily rounds.
Phil writes Taylor up and hands her a citation.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Good day, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That could've gone better...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: They don't? I thought they liked it when a man is in charge. $Scott said...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? That's what $Scott told you?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh, er... Maybe he didn't quite put it like that, but... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I guess you're right, Taylor. I don't really like C.R.E.E.P. at all. Something about Dyre just feels all wrong.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So you'll join our rebellion?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Your `rebellion?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your [color=#e23b3b][i]rebellion?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Phil, we don't like Dyre. He's done a lot of mean things, and he put me in a lockdown detention. I was in a classroom for eight hours, and I seriously injured my arm.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All I did was wear too much make-up. Being in that room was like being in prison... And I didn't even get to wear a slimming, orange jumpsuit!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I saw you agree with $Scott when he wanted to rebel against Dyre. This is your chance to stand up again.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Working with Hannah and Zach wasn't all that fun either.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So you'll turn a blind ear when things go down in the auditorium?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Can your ear be 'blind'?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can we count on you or not?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yes! I'll be the blindest ear you've ever seen.
The cheerleaders find Phil marching in uniform in the hall on his way to the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Phil! Just the guy I wanted to see...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Um... Halt! By order of Protocol-8, you are violators and offenders!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: And I should, um, write you up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, Phil is really bad at this...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My dad always did tell me someone else's incompetence is my advantage!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, Phil, did you just say 'Halt'? And are we violators, offenders, or both?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, that part really confused me.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I think you're both. Neither. Yes. Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Phil, level with me for a minute. Do you really like being a part of C.R.E.E.P.?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: C.R.E.E.P. is fantastic.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It doesn't sound that fantastic when you say it like that.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I like being in it. Besides, $Scott said that girls like... Um, never mind.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I am an expert in what girls like and don't like. And let me tell you, girls don't like...
Taylor moves closer to Zach and touches his hair.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Your hair is just so healthy-looking!
Taylor nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, um, yeah! It just looks so hair-like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's totally right! Do you put hair gel in it to make it look so neat?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Thanks, cheerleaders. My hair does look awesome. But I have a secret.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What secret is that?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I don't follow directions.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like that's a surprise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: When it says 'Lather, rinse, and repeat' on the bottle... I don't 'repeat'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fascinating! You sound like you know so much about hair.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm here all day, ladies.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam's hair looks so lackluster. She's been looking for some tips.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's okay, Sam, don't be so shy... Go ahead and listen to Zach talk `all day`...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay, Sam, don't be so shy... Go ahead and listen to Zach talk [color=#3b78e2][i]all day[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, Zach, my hair's just so... Unflexible.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I have this special thing... It's called 'gel'...
The cheerleaders leave Zach and Sam talking.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just one more with twenty minutes to go!
Taylor moves closer to Zach and stares him down!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Your eyes are `amazing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your eyes are [color=#3b78e2][i]amazing.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE, Sam, and Jessica crowd around to stare as well.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're so focused and round.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like windows!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You know what? As much as I like having a bunch of girls all over me... This is starting to freak me out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't like us staring soulfully into your eyes?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Not. Like. That.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Listen, I gotta go. I'll see you girls at the assembly?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah...
The cheerleaders leave Zach.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So Zach completely brushed us off... But we still have one left!
The cheerleaders find Zach in the gym.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What are you ladies doing? You're not supposed to be here.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That violates some whack-protocol-312 or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, Zach, forget about those rules. Have I ever told you how much I love your...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `What` did you say?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What[/i][/color] did you say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You heard me. Your shoes are horrendous. Did you mismatch them to make a fashion statement? Because that's more a question mark than an exclamation.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't mean it as an insult, sweetie. But that's why I was inviting you out. It's a disgrace for any C.R.E.E.P. member to go around wearing `those...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I didn't mean it as an insult, sweetie. But that's why I was inviting you out. It's a disgrace for any C.R.E.E.P. member to go around wearing [color=#3b78e2][i]those...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm sure Jessica wouldn't mind pitching in to help C.R.E.E.P. become more fashionable.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anything for the price of freedom....

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Gasp! When are you leaving for the mall?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica's leaving right as the assembly starts, aren't you, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yep! Right at that time!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Meet me in the parking lot, okay?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah!
The cheerleaders walk away.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, that's one down with forty minutes to go!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They're inspiring. You look so great in them!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know. Aren't they amazing? I have a special intuition for that kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that's just the kind of talent we need on our shoe shopping trip. So you'll come with us?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're the one who said I was inspiring. Why would I need to leave campus for that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Look, because you've been so nice and because you're so obviously fashion poor, I won't write you up for flagrantly disregarding the rules.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm going to see you at the assembly, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Right...
The cheerleaders walk away.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So Hannah's staying, but there's still a chance we can take the other two down.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's excellent! We need to get into Dyre's system.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: His system? Are we going to blast down his defenses, hack into his hyper-core security mainframes, and send out troops into his alien encampment?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That... Or take over the school cameras to control what Dyre can see.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ooh... Devious.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But do you boys think we can hack into it?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We can, or my name isn't Dexter Edison Albright!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is it?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...Yes.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And you all brought your laptops with you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Like you asked.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I sleep with mine.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Strange, but unsurprising.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All right. Let's get started.
After an hour or so of working...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh no...
Dex and Brendan both type furiously on their computers.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't think we can get in...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But you and Dex are our best hackers!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, but Angie, this isn't Wilson during the prank wars. Dyre's system is much harder to break into.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You said that $Scott couldn't get into Dyre's computer? Well, the surveillance cameras and equipment are all on that same network.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're not getting into the mainframe. At least not with our current set of skills.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh no! What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait, hold on... I found something interesting in the campus security mainframe... Something we `can` hack into...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, hold on... I found something interesting in the campus security mainframe... Something we [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] hack into...

nodes.text: Brendan shows Angie something on his screen.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Brendan, if you can get control of that, I think I have an idea...
And so the nerds hacked through the night...
As $Scott put his people into place...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So what do you think? Are you in?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Definitely, bro. Anything that gets rid of Dyre and his ridiculous no-PDA rules...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: After that ridealong he put me through? You don't have to ask twice.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Totally in! We have to get him before he bans mini-skirts as official cheerleading uniforms.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll lend my professional services... I'll even do it for free just to get rid of that old goat.
And $Scott and Angie's plan was set into motion...
Now let's check in with Taylor... It's up to her and the cheerleaders to stop C.R.E.E.P.! Can you help them get the job done?
An hour before school, Taylor finds $ZOE, Sam, and Jessica huddled under the bleachers in the football field.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yawn... Why is it so important that you had to drag us out of bed so early?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because you listen to me as your cheerleading captain.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that we've been doing much cheerleading at all since Dyre became principal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, today is our day to get back at Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $Scott's back, and he has an important mission for us. It will determine the future of the school, and more importantly, the future of cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm in! I'm tired of cheering for standardized testing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Me too. But what are we supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're going to take care of C.R.E.E.P.!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm sick of them getting in my business and patrolling the hallways.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good. Then listen up. C.R.E.E.P. has three main leaders: Hannah, whose weakness is shopping. Zach, whose weakness is himself. And Phil, who... Well, we'll figure out his weakness.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We want to distract all three of them, and we have an hour to do that before the assembly starts!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So this mission starts now. Come on!
Taylor and the girls find Hannah on the stage, directing activities!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Get a move on, Auto-Club! Dyre's morning assembly is happening in an hour, and we've barely got this stage set up. Microphones! Wires! Lights!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Check, check, check. Hannah, we've been over this a million times. Can't we...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Silence!
Taylor approaches Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hannah! It's wonderful to see you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Cheerleading squad... What do you want? What happened to the SAT Prep cheers I told you to learn?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We love them so much, we've already learned them all by heart. We love the SATs, don't we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But we need a break. And we were just discussing how much we want to go shopping, and how much we want to make an emergency fashion run during the school assembly...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know that violates Protocol-20: All students must attend morning assembly. I could write you up for that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You could do that, or you could... Not.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And why would I ignore that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hear me out. Your shoes are...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No longer will protocols rule our lives and diminish our capacity as humans!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No longer will we have to be on our best behavior at all times!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No longer will we have to endure the ban on games at school...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Or limit our free time to academic work instead of our favorite extracurricular activity, video game, or franchise TV series!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And no longer will we have to reorganize all the paperwork in the office to fit the horrendous color-coding of the new regime!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You had to do that?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No longer! Are you ready to take down Dyre?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Yeah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yeah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah! We let that lousy guy take gaming away from us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've been waiting for this moment since he put me in that lockdown room.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And not just for your safety! For the safety of the school!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No boy, girl, or mascot will be secure as long as the protocols remain!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No form of video and commercial entertainment will be protected as long as Dyre became around to take it away!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This is it, men. The last chance you'll ever have to redeem yourselves is here! And now!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Lose this battle, and lose your soul...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Scary... But `cool.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Scary... But [color=#e23b3b][i]cool.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Huff. Huff. Huff.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Dex, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think he's hyperventilating. You were kinda scary, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: My... My inhaler can't take such heavy use...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry... I wanted to inspire you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's okay, Angie. Ever since Dyre put me into that lockdown room, I'm more than inspired.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Where should we start?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You don't happen to know how to dispatch C.R.E.E.P., distract Dyre, and pick locks, do you?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, but I'm not the only one who'll be helping. $Scott, the entire school's ready to rebel! Here's what we'll do...
One hour later...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...To summarize, the nerds will hack into the surveillance system to control the cameras...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The cheerleaders distract the C.R.E.E.P. leaders...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hector and Howard will cause a bunch of chaos in the assembly...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And then Colt will lock-pick his way into Dyre's office, and we'll find proof and send it to the police!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, this sounds perfect!
$Scott and Angie embrace... Then pull away awkwardly.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ahem. Good work, Anj. This sounds like our best shot.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks. Um, I'll call the nerds over and see what we can do at my house.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And I'll start calling the others. You're the best, Anj. Good bye!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Be safe, $Scott!
$Scott leaves the room, and Angie calls the nerds over.
Twenty minutes later, Angie steps aside to let Brendan, Dex, and Erik into her room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Angie. You called?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've never been in a girl's room before. It smells like flowers! And magic!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks for coming, guys, but can you keep your voices down? My dad's super strict. If he knew you were in here...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Understood! Commencing whispering...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry to call you here so late. But this is an emergency!
Angie explains $Scott's situation and their plan to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I need you to hack into the school's system so we can help out.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know why people keep thinking I can hack... I really can't...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, Angie, I don't know... I really don't want to get sent to Boot Camp...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Guys! Breaking into the school system is the most important thing you'll probably do this year. And you're doing this...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You... You did?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I missed you too! So does that maybe mean there's still a chance for us?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Even if that's how I feel, it doesn't mean we can be together. I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said anything.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh. I see. Yeah, guess I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I'll still help you. Dyre's horrible!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks for your help, Anj!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, anything for you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...And Centerscore, of course.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, for a second there, I thought... Forget it. Anything for Centerscore, right?
One Sunday evening, Angie lies in bed, tossing and turning.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This is no use. I can't sleep! Ever since $Scott left, things at school have been getting, well, `dire.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is no use. I can't sleep! Ever since $Scott left, things at school have been getting, well, [color=#3b78e2][i]dire.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The principal's made everything oppressively academic... We've been losing kids to Boot Camp... And Justin won't stop any of it! If there were a way to change things...
Suddenly, there's a tapping at her window! Angie walks over to see... `$Scott!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Suddenly, there's a tapping at her window! Angie walks over to see... [b]$Scott![/b]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Hey, Anj. We need to talk. Can I come in?
Angie steps back to let $Scott inside.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, you look like you've just run a marathon.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure that's what I just did.

nodes.speaker: Scott

nodes.text: What are you looking at?

nodes.text: Oh, $Scott, I didn't want to do it, but he was going to take it to the school board, and I didn't want you to get suspended...

nodes.text: I love you too.

You played a great game!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Crap?

nodes.text: I can't believe I once admired Dyre for his firm hand, his harsh words, his dictatorial manner!

nodes.text: Let's take him down!

nodes.text: It's all here... Bank accounts that funnel the money, an informal log of all the transactions between Discipline Corps. and Dyre...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'd feel a little bad for him if I wasn't so mad at what he's done.

nodes.text_bbcode: Oh well. I'm sending this out to every law enforcement area in the county [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] the media stations!

nodes.text: `What. Is. Going. On?`

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: How'd you get out? What did you do with Colt?

nodes.text: That no-good ragamuffin took off the moment he saw me.

nodes.text: I guess I should've seen that coming.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Indeed. Now you boys are in very serious trouble.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not as much trouble as you're going to be in. And I don't think they send you to Boot Camp for something like this.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.text: We know all about your scheme to make money off the Boot Camp!

nodes.text: You know what you're accusing me of? That's bribery and extortion. And I won't tolerate...
At that moment, Officer Monte and Colt step into the office.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This boy here has reported some criminal activity related to you, Viktor Dyre.

nodes.text: And you're going to listen to a miscreant like him?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not a miscreant, sir. A `junior detective.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not a miscreant, sir. A [color=#e23b3b][i]junior detective.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Besides, I also just received some incriminating evidence that calls for your immediate detainment. It's a good thing I was in the area.

nodes.text: I understand you've been charged with accepting bribes to send young offenders to Boot Camp.

nodes.text: This is the only room that's not connected to your security mainframe, and the only one we could hack into.
